comment: TPM vendor trust anchors for EK certificates, embedded in the core that runs in the phone app. See README.md in this directory before adding or changing anything.

vendors.name: Intel PTT
vendors.description: Intel Platform Trust Technology (firmware TPM in the CSME). The per-machine CAs (CSME MCC ROM CA, Kernel CA, PTT SVN) come from the TPM itself, NV index 0x01C00100.
